55323-garryowen.title: Garryowen
55323-garryowen.creator: H. De Vere Stacpoole
55323-garryowen.description: A book by H. De Vere Stacpoole. Out here on the moors, under the sun on a day like this, you are in the pleasant company of Laziness and Loneliness and Distance and Summer. The scent of the gorse is mixed with the scent of the sea, and the silence of the far-off hills with the sound of the billows booming amidst the coves of the coast.

arxiv-2104-11367.title: Restriction of exponential sums to hypersurfaces Thanks: The first author is partially supported by the NSF grant DMS-1800305. The second author is supported by the National Science Centre of Poland within the research project OPUS 2017/27/B/ST1/01623.
arxiv-2104-11367.creator: Ciprian Demeter, Bartosz Langowski
arxiv-2104-11367.description: Abstract . We prove moment inequalities for exponential sums with respect to singular measures, whose Fourier decay matches those of curved hypersurfaces. Our emphasis will be on proving estimates that are sharp with respect to the scale parameter N N , apart from N ϵ N^{\epsilon} losses. In a few instances, we manage to remove these losses.

arxiv-2107-14499.title: PC4PM: A Tool for Privacy/Confidentiality Preservation in Process Mining
arxiv-2107-14499.creator: Majid Rafiei, Alexander Schnitzler, Wil M.P. van der Aalst
arxiv-2107-14499.description: Abstract Process mining enables business owners to discover and analyze their actual processes using event data that are widely available in information systems. Event data contain detailed information which is incredibly valuable for providing insights. However, such detailed data often include highly confidential and private information.

arxiv-2207-14346.title: A Rosetta Stone for eccentric gravitational waveform models PyCBC ( Biwer et al. 2019 ) , LALSuite ( LIGO Scientific Collaboration 2018 ) , SciPy ( Virtanen et al. 2020 ) , Bilby ( Ashton et al. 2019 ; Romero-Shaw et al. 2020 ) , Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 )
arxiv-2207-14346.creator: Alan M. Knee, Isobel M. Romero-Shaw, Paul D. Lasky, Jess McIver, Eric Thrane
arxiv-2207-14346.description: Abstract Orbital eccentricity is a key signature of dynamical binary black hole formation. The gravitational waves from a coalescing binary contain information about its orbital eccentricity, which may be measured if the binary retains sufficient eccentricity near merger. Dedicated waveforms are required to measure eccentricity.

arxiv-2208-03891.title: The chemical abundance pattern of the extremely metal-poor thin disk star 2MASS J1808 − - 5104 and its origins Thanks: This paper includes data gathered with the 6.5 m Magellan Telescopes located at Las Campanas Observatory, Chile. 2015 The chemical abundance pattern of the extremely metal-poor thin
arxiv-2208-03891.creator: Mohammad K. Mardini, Anna Frebel, Rana Ezzeddine, Anirudh Chiti, Yohai Meiron, Alexander P. Ji, Vinicius M. Placco, Ian U. Roederer, Jorge Meléndez
arxiv-2208-03891.description: Abstract We present a high-resolution ( R ∼ 35,000 R\sim 35,000 ), high signal-to-noise ( S / N = 350 S/N=350 ) Magellan/MIKE spectrum of the bright extremely metal-poor star 2MASS J1808 − - 5104. We find [Fe/H] = − - 4.01 (spectroscopic LTE stellar parameters), [Fe/H] = − - 3.8 (photometric stellar parameters), [Fe/H] = − - 3.

arxiv-2209-10739.title: Supplementary Information: A multi k k -point nonadiabatic molecular dynamics for periodic systems
arxiv-2209-10739.creator: Fan Zheng, Lin-wang Wang
arxiv-2209-10739.description: Abstract • Derivation of cross- k non-adiabatic couplings • ab initio MD calculation details • Finite-size effect for eigen energy fluctuation during MD • Eigen states from \Gamma point only and DOS • Decoherence induced surface hopping (DISH) • Decoherence time • Orthonormalization of overlap matrix • Convergence of number of trajectories • k -point grid convergence with DP •

arxiv-2210-04501.title: Effects of viscosity on liquid structures produced by in-air microfluidics
arxiv-2210-04501.creator: David Baumgartner, Günter Brenn, Carole Planchette
arxiv-2210-04501.description: Abstract This study experimentally investigates the effect of viscosity on the outcomes of collisions between a regular stream of droplets and a continuous liquid jet. A broad variation of liquid viscosity of both the drop and the jet liquid is considered, keeping other material properties unchanged.

arxiv-2309-04410.title: DeformToon3D : Deformable Neural Radiance Fields for 3D Toonification
arxiv-2309-04410.creator: Junzhe Zhang, Yushi Lan, Shuai Yang, Fangzhou Hong, Quan Wang, Chai Kiat Yeo, Ziwei Liu, Chen Change Loy
arxiv-2309-04410.description: Abstract In this paper, we address the challenging problem of 3D toonification, which involves transferring the style of an artistic domain onto a target 3D face with stylized geometry and texture. Although fine-tuning a pre-trained 3D GAN on the artistic domain can produce reasonable performance, this strategy has limitations in the 3D domain.

arxiv-2311-04996.title: GPU-Accelerated WFST Beam Search Decoder for CTC-based Speech Recognition
arxiv-2311-04996.creator: Daniel Galvez, Tim Kaldewey
arxiv-2311-04996.description: Abstract While Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) models deliver state-of-the-art accuracy in automated speech recognition (ASR) pipelines, their performance has been limited by CPU-based beam search decoding. We introduce a GPU-accelerated Weighted Finite State Transducer (WFST) beam search decoder compatible with current CTC models.

arxiv-2406-12941.title: Metered Parking Functions
arxiv-2406-12941.creator: Spencer Daugherty, Pamela E. Harris, Ian Klein, Matt McClinton
arxiv-2406-12941.description: Abstract . We introduce a generalization of parking functions called t t -metered ( m , n ) (m,n) -parking functions, in which one of m m cars parks among n n spots per hour then leaves after t t hours.

arxiv-2501-10691.title: The thread embodiment of holographic quantum entanglement
arxiv-2501-10691.creator: Yi-Yu Lin 1,2
arxiv-2501-10691.description: Abstract This paper systematically develops the concept of entanglement threads that characterize the entanglement structure of holographic duality. Behind this framework lies a simple philosophy: holographic quantum entanglement can be visualized using thread-like objects. Inspired by the fact that tensor network models can be deformed into a quantum circuit form with flow-conserving features, we abstract the concept of entanglement threads.

arxiv-2602-13074.title: Evolution of Linear Perturbations under Time-Dependent Hubble Friction I: SR-USR-SR Inflation
arxiv-2602-13074.creator: Wen Li, Chao Chen
arxiv-2602-13074.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Wen Li, Chao Chen. In this paper, we revisit the linear perturbation (including the comoving curvature perturbation and field perturbation) dynamics in the SR–USR–SR inflation with instantaneous transitions. Using the junction method and asymptotic expansions of Hankel functions, we derive accurate asymptotic expressions for the time evolution of mode functions and the resulting power spectrum, based on three systematic rules for identifying the dominant terms across transitions.

arxiv-2605-02620.creator: Andreas K. Maier, Moritz Zaiss, Siming Bayer

pmc-11312482.title: Species of the Sections Hedysarum and Multicaulia of the Genus Hedysarum (Fabaceae): Taxonomy, Distribution, Chromosomes, Genomes, and Phylogeny
pmc-11312482.creator: Olga Yu Yurkevich, Tatiana E Samatadze, Svyatoslav A Zoshchuk, Alexandra V Amosova, Olga V Muravenko, Wenpan Dong
pmc-11312482.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The genus Hedysarum L. (Fabaceae) includes about 200 species of annual and perennial herbs distributed in Asia, Europe, North Africa, and North America. Many species of this genus are valuable medicinal, melliferous, and forage resources. In this review, we consider the taxonomic history of the genus Hedysarum, the chromosomal organization of the species from the sections Hedysarum and Multicaulia, as well as phylogenetic relationships between these sections.

pmc-13032159.title: Racial and Ethnic Reporting and Representation in US Alzheimer Clinical Trials
pmc-13032159.creator: Zhuoer Lin, Ruochen Sun, Joseph S. Ross, Kien Lau, Sophia Stumpf, Xi Chen
pmc-13032159.description: This systematic review analyzes patterns and trends in the reporting and representation of race and ethnicity in US-based phase 3 Alzheimer disease clinical trials from 1997 to 2023. Introduction Alzheimer disease (AD) affects more than 7 million Americans and disproportionately impacts racial and ethnic populations underrepresented in clinical research in the US.

pmc-13339304.title: Survival and safety: wedge resection, segmentectomy, and lobectomy in NSCLC
pmc-13339304.creator: Lin Qiu, Pingping Shao
pmc-13339304.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to compare the clinical outcomes of three surgical methods (wedge resection, segmentectomy and lobectomy) in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed 130 NSCLC patients who underwent thoracoscopic surgery. Patients were categorized into wedge resection (n = 50), segmentectomy (n = 40) and lobectomy (n = 40) groups.

pmc-13355470.title: Simultaneous supplementation of encapsulated amino acids and capped dietary starch levels improved growth performance of broiler chickens fed by low-protein diet
pmc-13355470.creator: Ramin Shahabi, Hassan Darmani Kuhi, Mohammad Roostaie Ali-Mehr, Houshang Lotfollahian
pmc-13355470.description: This experiment was designed to investigate the effect of encapsulated amino acids supplementation and capped dietary starch levels on the growth performance of broiler chicks fed low-protein diets. Dietary crude protein (CP) was gradually reduced from 200 g/kg (CP20, a high-protein baseline diet) to 180 g/kg (CP18) and 160 g/kg (CP16).

pmc-13440103.title: Lived experiences of women prescribed low-dose aspirin for preeclampsia prevention: a phenomenological study
pmc-13440103.creator: Prisca Asiimwe, Grace Nambozi, Laura Brennaman, Joseph Ngonzi, Gad Ruzaaza
pmc-13440103.description: BackgroundPreeclampsia is a prevalent issue causing significant suffering and deaths in Uganda. The Ministry of Health has introduced a policy mandating the use of low-dose aspirin for its prevention. Being a new intervention, the acceptability of this drug among the women for whom it is prescribed is still unexplored in Southwestern Uganda.
